## Lose Weight with Expert Care

At DrHouse, we believe effective weight loss starts with medical expertise, not guesswork. Our physicians use evidence-based treatments, including FDA-approved prescription medications, to help patients achieve sustainable results.

Every treatment plan is tailored to the individual, backed by clinical insight, and delivered through private, convenient telehealth visits.

If you’ve struggled to lose weight through diet and exercise alone, or you’re looking for a medically guided reset, our doctors are here to help you take control of your health, improve your well-being, and see real, measurable progress.

### A Smarter Way to Lose Weight

Through our telehealth platform, DrHouse brings expert medical care directly to your phone. Our weight loss program is designed for adults with obesity (BMI ≥30) or those who are overweight (BMI ≥27) with a weight-related health condition such as hypertension, type 2 diabetes, or sleep apnea.

With DrHouse, you don’t need to wait months for a specialist appointment or navigate complicated in-person programs. You get access to licensed doctors, weight loss consultations, lab testing referrals, and fast medication delivery (available in select areas)—all from the comfort and privacy of home.

### Why Choose DrHouse for Medical Weight Loss?

- **Professional medical care:** Every consultation is conducted by a licensed, board-certified physician who evaluates your health history, weight-related concerns, and overall eligibility for GLP-1 medications, following established clinical guidelines.
- **Prescription options when appropriate:** Our physicians can prescribe a range of FDA-approved GLP-1 medications, such as Zepbound, Wegovy, or Ozempic (and more), for eligible patients who meet clinical guidelines.
- **Fast, nationwide virtual care.** Whether you’re at home, at work, or on the go, DrHouse makes it easy to connect with a doctor from anywhere in the U.S.
- **24/7 access to care.** Start a virtual visit anytime, day or night. Our doctors are available 24/7 to help you begin or continue your weight loss journey.
- **Choose your doctor, and keep them.** Prefer consistency? Stick with the same doctor for follow-ups—or try a different one if you’d like a second opinion.
- **Ongoing personalized support.** Receive regular check-ins, medication reviews, lab assessments, and tailored lifestyle guidance throughout your treatment.
- **Flexible prescription fulfillment (where available).** If prescribed, your medication can be delivered directly to your door, picked up from your preferred pharmacy, or, in select areas, delivered in under an hour through our on-demand prescription delivery service. All options are designed to be fast, secure, and discreet.

### Prescription Weight Loss Medications

The physicians at DrHouse can prescribe several GLP-1 receptor agonists that are FDA-approved for chronic weight management. These medications work by mimicking gut hormones that reduce appetite, improve blood sugar regulation, and support long-term fat loss.

Each medication is selected based on your health profile, treatment goals, and how well your body responds during follow-up care.

#### [**Zepbound (tirzepatide)**](https://drhouse.com/telehealth/online-prescriptions/zepbound/)

- Weekly injectable
- Dual-agonist targeting GIP and GLP-1 receptors
- Shown to reduce body weight by an average of 20.9% (approx. 48 lbs) in the [SURMOUNT-1 clinical trial](https://zepbound.lilly.com/weight/what-is-zepbound?)
- Especially effective for individuals with obesity or metabolic health conditions

#### **Mounjaro (tirzepatide)**

- Weekly injectable
- Same active ingredient as Zepbound, with broad clinical use in both diabetes and weight loss
- In SURPASS trials, patients with type 2 diabetes lost up to 22.5 lbs over 40 weeks
- Often used for individuals needing improved glycemic control alongside weight loss

#### **Wegovy (semaglutide)**

- Weekly injectable
- Targets GLP-1 receptors to curb hunger and increase feelings of fullness
- **Participants in STEP trials lost up to 15% of body weight over 68 weeks**
- Well-suited for patients focused on appetite management and gradual, sustained loss

#### **Ozempic (semaglutide)**

- Weekly injectable
- Originally developed for type 2 diabetes but frequently prescribed off-label for weight loss
- Associated with 13.5 lbs average weight loss in patients with diabetes over 40 weeks

#### **Rybelsus (semaglutide oral tablet)**

- Daily oral tablet
- First and only oral GLP-1 medication available
- In PIONEER trials, patients lost 6.8–9.7 lbs on average, depending on dose and duration
- A good option for individuals who prefer pills over injections

Physicians at DrHouse may also prescribe or recommend other medications, referrals, or alternatives based on your unique health profile, lab results, medication history, and how well you respond to treatment. All prescribing decisions are made on a case-by-case basis during your consultation, with your safety and long-term success as the top priorities.

### **Personalized treatment plans**

At DrHouse, we believe that each person’s weight loss journey is unique. During your initial consultation, our medical team will conduct a thorough review of your health history, lifestyle, and weight loss goals.

Based on these insights, we create a treatment plan tailored to your specific needs. This plan may include:

- **Dietary and physical activity guidance**: Personalized recommendations to support sustainable weight loss alongside Zepbound.
- **Regular check-ins**: Follow-up appointments to track progress, adjust treatment as needed, and address any questions or challenges.
- **Continued support**: Ongoing encouragement and guidance to help maintain motivation and accountability throughout your journey.

### Who’s Eligible for Prescription Weight Loss Medication?

Prescription weight loss medications can be life-changing tools—but they’re not for everyone. At DrHouse, our licensed physicians evaluate each patient individually to determine whether GLP-1 medications are appropriate and safe.

You may be eligible for a prescription if you meet one or more of the following:

- **Body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher**(classified as obese)
- **BMI of 27 or higher** with at least one weight-related medical condition, such as:
  - Type 2 diabetes
  - High blood pressure
  - High cholesterol
  - Sleep apnea
  - Cardiovascular disease
- **Not currently pregnant or breastfeeding**
- **Using reliable contraception** (if of childbearing potential)
- **No untreated or unstable mental health conditions** that could be impacted by weight loss medication
- **Willing to complete lab testing** (to ensure medications are prescribed safely)
- **Committed to lifestyle changes** including healthy eating, physical activity, and consistent follow-up care

All decisions are made during your virtual consultation based on a comprehensive review of your health history, goals, and lab results.

### How It Works

Starting your weight loss journey with DrHouse is simple, fast, and fully remote.

- **Book a virtual consultation:** Download the DrHouse app and schedule an appointment that works for you.
- **Meet with a doctor:** During your video visit, your physician will discuss your health history, answer your questions, and determine if prescription medication is appropriate.
- **Complete lab testing:** If needed, your doctor will refer you to a local lab for tests to ensure a safe and personalized plan.
- **Receive your treatment plan:** If eligible, you’ll receive a prescription and clear guidance on how to take your medication and track progress.
- **Stay connected:** Check in to assess progress, adjust your dose, and get continued support.
- **Get your medication, your way:** If prescribed, your medication can be delivered directly to your door, picked up from your preferred pharmacy, or—where available—delivered in under an hour through our on-demand prescription delivery service.

### So Don’t Wait Any Longer—Start Your Weight Loss Journey with DrHouse!

If you’re ready to take control of your health, DrHouse is here to help. With expert care, proven treatments, and unmatched convenience, our telehealth weight loss program is built to help you feel confident in your body again.

**Book your virtual consultation today** and take the first step toward lasting weight loss and a healthier future.

### **Frequently Asked Questions**

#### **Can I get weight loss medication online?**

Yes, at DrHouse, we offer virtual consultations, prescriptions, and discreet medication delivery for your convenience. Our team of physicians will conduct a thorough assessment to determine the best treatment plan for you, which may include prescription weight loss medication like Zepbound.

#### **Who can prescribe weight loss medication?**

At DrHouse, our experienced physicians are licensed to prescribe weight loss medication for eligible patients. We conduct a thorough evaluation of each patient’s health history and goals to determine the best course of treatment.

#### **What can I expect during a virtual consultation with an online doctor?**

During your virtual consultation, your doctor will review your health history, discuss any weight loss goals, and determine if medication is suitable for you. If you are deemed eligible, your doctor will provide a personalized treatment plan and an online prescription for weight loss medication. You can also ask any questions or address any concerns during the consultation.

#### **What is the process for starting the weight loss program?**

To get started, download the DrHouse app and schedule a virtual consultation. Your doctor will review your health history, discuss your goals, and determine if medication or lab testing is appropriate. If eligible, you’ll receive a personalized plan and guidance on next steps.

#### **I have a normal BMI—am I still eligible for a weight loss prescription?**

In general, weight loss medications are prescribed to adults with a BMI of 30 or higher, or 27 with at least one weight-related health condition. If your BMI is in the normal range, weight loss medications are unlikely to be prescribed, but your DrHouse physician can still discuss other health and wellness options.

#### **What weight loss medication can the physicians at DrHouse prescribe?**

Physicians at DrHouse may prescribe FDA-approved GLP-1 medications such as Zepbound, Wegovy, Ozempic, Mounjaro, or Rybelsus, depending on your medical history, BMI, lab results, and clinical eligibility.

#### **What weight loss medication is right for me?**

Your DrHouse provider will help determine the best medication based on your health status, weight loss needs, and other factors discussed during your consultation.

#### **Are there any side effects of weight loss medication?**

As with any medication, weight loss drugs can have side effects, which may vary from mild to more noticeable. Your doctor will go over potential side effects and how to manage them, ensuring you feel prepared and supported.

#### **What should I do if I experience side effects?**

If you experience any side effects, contact your DrHouse provider through the app. They may adjust your treatment plan or provide guidance on managing any symptoms.

#### **How fast do you lose weight with medical weight loss?**

Weight loss rates vary based on individual factors and the specific medication. Some patients may see initial results within a few weeks, but sustainable weight loss usually occurs gradually. Your DrHouse provider will help you set realistic expectations.

#### **How long do I need to take the weight loss medication?**

The length of treatment depends on your progress and health goals. Many patients use medication as part of a broader, long-term plan. Your DrHouse provider will guide you on the appropriate treatment duration.

#### **Will my insurance cover the cost of my online weight loss treatment?**

Insurance coverage for weight loss medications varies widely. DrHouse accepts many insurance plans for virtual doctor visits, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, Elevance Health (formerly Anthem), and Medicare. However, medication coverage is dependent on your specific insurance plan. We recommend checking with your provider to confirm what is included.

#### **Do I still need to diet and exercise while taking weight loss medication?**

Yes, medication is most effective when combined with healthy lifestyle changes. Your DrHouse provider will recommend dietary and physical activity guidelines to support your weight loss.

#### **What lifestyle changes are recommended while on weight loss medication?**

Our team of physician, modifications, increased physical activity, and behavioral changes to support your weight loss journey. Our goal is to help you adopt sustainable habits for long-term success.

#### **What if the prescribed medication doesn’t work for me?**

If your current medication isn’t delivering the results you hoped for, your DrHouse provider may adjust your plan or explore alternative options that better fit your needs.

#### **How do I schedule follow-up visits with my online doctor?**

Scheduling follow-up appointments is easy through the DrHouse app. You can book appointments at your convenience to check in on your progress, make adjustments to your plan, or discuss any questions with your provider.

#### **Is virtual weight loss treatment as effective as in-person care?**

Yes, studies show that virtual care can be as effective as in-person treatment for managing chronic conditions like obesity, especially when care includes physician oversight, personalized plans, and follow-ups. DrHouse offers all of these elements through our telehealth platform.

## Frequently asked questions

- ### What Types of Medical Services Are Provided By DrHouse?

![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-down-small.be5347.svg)![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-up-small.f91843.svg)



DrHouse offers a wide array of telehealth services tailored to meet diverse patient needs.



Our primary services include urgent care and primary care consultations, which cover immediate medical assistance for non-life-threatening conditions as well as comprehensive healthcare for chronic and ongoing medical concerns.



We also provide specialized condition-based services, including dermatology appointments, men’s health, and women’s health visits.



Our team of licensed physicians has expertise in various medical fields to ensure that we can address a wide range of patient needs effectively and efficiently.

- ### How Does DrHouse Work?

![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-down-small.be5347.svg)![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-up-small.f91843.svg)



DrHouse operates on the principles of convenience, accessibility, and quality healthcare. Our telehealth platform is designed to provide on-demand doctors’ visits for urgent care needs, sparing you the hassle of prolonged waiting periods and ensuring timely medical assistance.



Using DrHouse is a straightforward process. All you need to do is follow a few easy steps:



  - Download the DrHouse telehealth app on your mobile device.
  - Create an account by providing basic information and medical history.
  - Start an on-demand virtual video consultation with one of our licensed physicians.
  - Discuss your medical needs and concerns with one of our physicians.
  - A doctor will review your medical history, symptoms, and current medications (if any) to create a personalized treatment plan.
  - If necessary, a doctor will electronically send a prescription to your chosen pharmacy.

For more information visit our “ [How DrHouse Works](https://drhouse.com/how-drhouse-works/)” page.

- ### What Does an Appointment Look Like?

![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-down-small.be5347.svg)![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-up-small.f91843.svg)



During your virtual consultation with a DrHouse physician, you will have the opportunity to discuss your medical needs and concerns.



The consultation will consist of a video call where the physician will assess your medical history and ask you questions about your symptoms and any other relevant information. This is to ensure that the physician has all the necessary information to make an informed decision about your treatment plan.



The physician may also request additional information or diagnostic tests, such as blood work or imaging if needed.



You can also ask any questions or clarify any doubts you may have about your condition or medication. Our physicians are happy to address any concerns you may have.



Once the physician has assessed your needs, they will create a personalized treatment plan, which may include prescribing medication or recommending further medical care.

- ### How Long Does It Take To Get Treatment With DrHouse?

![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-down-small.be5347.svg)![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-up-small.f91843.svg)



At DrHouse, we understand the value of your time and health, which is why our on-demand urgent care service is designed to work quickly and efficiently. From the moment you request a consultation, it takes only up to 15 minutes to see a doctor.

- ### Can DrHouse's Virtual Doctors Prescribe Medication?

![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-down-small.be5347.svg)![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-up-small.f91843.svg)



Yes, physicians at DrHouse can prescribe almost any medication, including refills, that is not classified as a controlled substance. DrHouse physicians also will not prescribe Gabapentin, medical marijuana, muscle relaxants, or HRT medications. It’s crucial to note that the prescription of any medication is purely at the discretion of our healthcare professionals.



They will assess your medical history, symptoms, and current medications to determine the most appropriate treatment plan for you. If your physician believes that a certain medication is necessary for your well-being, it will be prescribed.

- ### Are DrHouse Telehealth Services Safe?

![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-down-small.be5347.svg)![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-up-small.f91843.svg)



Absolutely, it is safe to use DrHouse. We are committed to ensuring the highest standards of patient safety and privacy.



All our providers are highly qualified US-based physicians and often affiliated with major hospitals. They are board-certified and from the top U.S. medical schools with an average of 20 years of experience.



We strictly adhere to HIPAA regulations, ensuring your personal and medical information is kept secure and confidential. Also, we comply with all applicable state and federal laws related to telehealth and the prescribing and refilling of medications.



Therefore, you can rest assured knowing that your safety and privacy are our top priorities when you use DrHouse’s services.

- ### How Much Does DrHouse Cost?

![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-down-small.be5347.svg)![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-up-small.f91843.svg)



DrHouse strives to provide accessible and affordable telehealth services. DrHouse urgent care, primary care, and specialist visits are $129 or your copay. This includes everything from your initial consultation through to the prescription of your medication.



The cost of a doctor’s visit may be covered fully by your insurance. A typical copay is around $25. We recommend checking with your insurance provider to understand the extent of your coverage for telehealth services.



To learn more about how much DrHouse costs, visit our [pricing page](https://drhouse.com/pricing/).

- ### Does DrHouse Accept Insurance?

![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-down-small.be5347.svg)![](https://drhouse.com/app/themes/drhouse/public/svgs/2024/chevron-up-small.f91843.svg)



Yes, DrHouse accepts most major insurances, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, Medicare, Humana, and Elevance Health (formerly Anthem). The extent of coverage may vary depending on your individual plan.
